translations.idiomatic: When Jian'an Circuit cast an image of the Jade Emperor, he served as commissioner for receiving and escorting it.

sentences.zh: 朝謁太清宮，為奉祀經度制置使、判亳州。

translations.literal: For the audience at the Grand Pure Temple he served as commissioner for the preparatory arrangements of the sacrificial rites and was assigned to Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: For the audience at the Grand Pure Temple he served as commissioner for the preparatory arrangements of the sacrificial rites and was assigned to Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 帝賜宴賦詩以寵其行，命權管勾駕前兵馬事。

translations.literal: The emperor granted a banquet and composed a poem to honor his departure, and ordered him to act in charge of troops and horses before the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted a banquet and composed a poem to honor his departure, and ordered him to act in charge of troops and horses before the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 謂獻白鹿並靈芝九萬五千本。

translations.literal: Wei presented a white deer together with ninety-five thousand specimens of lingzhi fungus.
translations.idiomatic: Wei presented a white deer together with ninety-five thousand specimens of lingzhi fungus.

sentences.zh: 還，判禮儀院，又為修景靈宮使，摹寫天書刻玉笈，玉清昭應宮副使。

translations.literal: Upon returning he was assigned to the Court of Ceremonial, again served as commissioner for construction of the Jingling Palace, copied the Heavenly Writ for carving on jade caskets, and was deputy commissioner of the Yujing Zhaoying Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Upon returning he was assigned to the Court of Ceremonial, again served as commissioner for construction of the Jingling Palace, copied the Heavenly Writ for carving on jade caskets, and was deputy commissioner of the Yujing Zhaoying Palace.

sentences.zh: 大內火，為修葺使。

translations.literal: When fire broke out in the inner palace, he served as commissioner for repairs.
translations.idiomatic: When fire broke out in the inner palace, he served as commissioner for repairs.

sentences.zh: 曆工、刑、兵三部尚書，再為天書儀衛副使，拜平江軍節度使、知升州。

translations.literal: He served in succession as minister of works, justice, and war, again served as deputy director of rites for the Heavenly Writ, and was appointed military commissioner of the Pingjiang Army and prefect of Shengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as minister of works, justice, and war, again served as deputy director of rites for the Heavenly Writ, and was appointed military commissioner of the Pingjiang Army and prefect of Shengzhou.

sentences.zh: 天禧初，徙保信軍節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianxi he was transferred to military commissioner of the Baoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianxi he was transferred to military commissioner of the Baoxin Army.

sentences.zh: 三年，以吏部尚書復參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third year, as minister of personnel he again became participant in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, as minister of personnel he again became vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，祀南郊，輔臣俱進官。

translations.literal: That year, when the southern suburban sacrifice was performed, all the senior ministers were promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: That year, when the southern suburban sacrifice was performed, all the senior ministers were promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 故事，嘗為宰相而除樞密使，始得遷僕射，乃以謂檢校太尉兼本官為樞密使。

translations.literal: By precedent, one who had once been grand councilor and was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs could then be promoted to vice director. Wei was therefore made honorary grand commandant while retaining his original rank as director of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, one who had once been grand councilor and was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs could then be promoted to vice director. Wei was therefore made honorary grand commandant while retaining his original rank as director of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 時寇準為相，尤惡謂，謂媒蘖其過，遂罷準相。

translations.literal: At that time Kou Zhun was grand councilor and especially hated Wei. Wei slandered him for his faults, and Zhun was thereupon removed from the grand council.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Kou Zhun was grand councilor and especially hated Wei. Wei slandered him for his faults, and Zhun was thereupon removed from the grand council.

sentences.zh: 既而拜謂同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士、監修國史、玉清昭應宮使。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Wei was appointed grand councilor with equal standing at the Secretariat-Chancellery, senior academician of the Academy of Literary Glory, overseer of the compilation of the national history, and commissioner of the Yujing Zhaoying Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Wei was appointed grand councilor with equal standing at the Secretariat-Chancellery, senior academician of the Academy of Literary Glory, overseer of the compilation of the national history, and commissioner of the Yujing Zhaoying Palace.

sentences.zh: 周懷政事敗，議再貶準，帝意欲謫準江、淮間，謂退，除道州司馬。

translations.literal: When Zhou Huai's affair failed, there was discussion of demoting Zhun again. The emperor intended to exile Zhun to the region between the Yangzi and Huai rivers. Wei withdrew, and Zhun was appointed army adjutant in Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou Huai's affair failed, there was discussion of demoting Zhun again. The emperor intended to exile Zhun to the region between the Yangzi and Huai rivers. Wei withdrew, and Zhun was appointed army adjutant in Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 同列不敢言，獨王曾以帝語質之，謂顧曰：「居停主人勿復言。」

translations.literal: His colleagues on the council dared not speak. Only Wang Zeng confronted him with the emperor's words. Wei looked back and said: "Landlord, say no more."
translations.idiomatic: His colleagues on the council dared not speak. Only Wang Zeng confronted him with the emperor's words. Wei looked back and said: "Landlord, say no more."

sentences.zh: 蓋指曾以第舍假準也。

translations.literal: This referred to the fact that Zeng had lent his residence to Zhun.
translations.idiomatic: This referred to the fact that Zeng had lent his residence to Zhun.

sentences.zh: 仁宗即位，進司徒兼侍中，為山陵使。

translations.literal: When Renzong ascended the throne, Wei was promoted to minister of education with concurrent appointment as palace attendant and made commissioner for the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong ascended the throne, Wei was promoted to minister of education with concurrent appointment as palace attendant and made commissioner for the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 寇準、李迪再貶，謂取制草改曰：「當醜徒幹紀之際，屬先王違豫之初，罹此震驚，遂至沈劇。」

translations.literal: When Kou Zhun and Li Di were demoted again, Wei took the draft edict and changed it to read: "At a time when wicked men were disturbing discipline, just as the late emperor's illness was beginning, he suffered this shock and his condition became grave."
translations.idiomatic: When Kou Zhun and Li Di were demoted again, Wei took the draft edict and changed it to read: "At a time when wicked men were disturbing discipline, just as the late emperor's illness was beginning, he suffered this shock and his condition became grave."

sentences.zh: 凡與準善者，盡逐之。

translations.literal: All who were on good terms with Zhun were driven out.
translations.idiomatic: All who were on good terms with Zhun were driven out.

sentences.zh: 是時二府定議，太后與帝五日一御便殿聽政。

translations.literal: At that time the two councils decided that the empress dowager and the emperor would jointly hold court in the side hall every five days to hear affairs of government.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the two councils decided that the empress dowager and the emperor would jointly hold court in the side hall every five days to hear affairs of government.

sentences.zh: 既得旨，而謂潛結內侍雷允恭，令密請太后降手書，軍國事進入印畫。

translations.literal: Once this had received approval, Wei secretly allied himself with the palace attendant Lei Yungong and had him privately request that the empress dowager issue a handwritten order that military and state affairs be submitted for her seal and endorsement.
translations.idiomatic: Once this had received approval, Wei secretly allied himself with the palace attendant Lei Yungong and had him privately request that the empress dowager issue a handwritten order that military and state affairs be submitted for her seal and endorsement.

sentences.zh: 學士草制辭，允恭先持示謂，閱訖乃進。

translations.literal: When the academicians drafted the edict, Yungong first showed it to Wei, and only after Wei had read it was it submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the academicians drafted the edict, Yungong first showed it to Wei, and only after Wei had read it was it submitted.

sentences.zh: 蓋謂欲獨任允恭傳達中旨，而不欲同列與聞機政也。

translations.literal: This was because Wei wished to rely on Yungong alone to convey the inner court's intent and did not want his colleagues to hear of state secrets.
translations.idiomatic: This was because Wei wished to rely on Yungong alone to convey the inner court's intent and did not want his colleagues to hear of state secrets.

sentences.zh: 允恭倚謂勢，益橫無所憚。

translations.literal: Yungong relied on Wei's power and grew ever more arrogant and fearless.
translations.idiomatic: Yungong relied on Wei's power and grew ever more arrogant and fearless.

sentences.zh: 允恭方為山陵都監，與判司天監邢中和擅易皇堂地。

translations.literal: Yungong was then overall supervisor of the imperial tombs and, together with Xing Zhonghe, judge of the Directorate of Astronomy, arbitrarily changed the site of the imperial burial chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Yungong was then overall supervisor of the imperial tombs and, together with Xing Zhonghe, judge of the Directorate of Astronomy, arbitrarily changed the site of the imperial burial chamber.

sentences.zh: 夏守恩領工徒數萬穿地，土石相半，眾議日喧，懼不能成功，中作而罷，奏請待命。

translations.literal: Xia Shou'en led tens of thousands of laborers in digging. Earth and stone were evenly mixed, public discussion grew daily more clamorous, and fearing failure they halted work midway and memorialized requesting further orders.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Shou'en led tens of thousands of laborers in digging. Earth and stone were evenly mixed, public discussion grew daily more clamorous, and fearing failure they halted work midway and memorialized requesting further orders.

sentences.zh: 謂庇允恭，依違不決。

translations.literal: Wei shielded Yungong and wavered without making a decision.
translations.idiomatic: Wei shielded Yungong and wavered without making a decision.

sentences.zh: 內侍毛昌達自陵下還，以其事奏，詔問謂，謂始請遣使按視。

translations.literal: The palace attendant Mao Changda returned from the tombs and reported the matter. An edict questioned Wei, and only then did Wei request that envoys be dispatched to inspect the site.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant Mao Changda returned from the tombs and reported the matter. An edict questioned Wei, and only then did Wei request that envoys be dispatched to inspect the site.

sentences.zh: 既而咸謂復用舊地，乃詔馮拯、曹利用等就謂第議，遣王曾覆視，遂誅允恭。

translations.literal: Soon afterward all agreed to revert to the original site. An edict ordered Feng Zheng, Cao Liyong, and others to discuss the matter at Wei's residence, dispatched Wang Zeng to reinspect the site, and Yungong was thereupon executed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward all agreed to revert to the original site. An edict ordered Feng Zheng, Cao Liyong, and others to discuss the matter at Wei's residence, dispatched Wang Zeng to reinspect the site, and Yungong was thereupon executed.

sentences.zh: 後數日，太后與帝坐承明殿，召拯、利用等諭曰：「丁謂為宰輔，乃與宦官交通。」

translations.literal: Several days later the empress dowager and the emperor sat in Chenming Hall and summoned Feng Zheng, Cao Liyong, and others, saying: "Ding Wei, as grand councilor, has been in contact with eunuchs."
translations.idiomatic: Several days later the empress dowager and the emperor sat in Chenming Hall and summoned Feng Zheng, Cao Liyong, and others, saying: "Ding Wei, as grand councilor, has been in contact with eunuchs."

sentences.zh: 因出謂嘗托允恭令後苑匠所造金酒器示之，又出允恭嘗幹謂求管勾皇城司及三司衙司狀，因曰：「謂前附允恭奏事，皆言已與卿等議定，故皆可其奏；

translations.literal: She then produced gold wine vessels that Wei had once had Yungong commission from the rear-garden craftsmen, and also produced Yungong's petition asking Wei to secure charge of the Imperial City Office and the Three Departments yamen. She continued: "When Wei previously appended Yungong's memorials, he always said he had already discussed them with you, and so they were all approved;
translations.idiomatic: She then produced gold wine vessels that Wei had once had Yungong commission from the rear-garden craftsmen, and also produced Yungong's petition asking Wei to secure charge of the Imperial City Office and the Three Departments yamen. She continued: "When Wei previously appended Yungong's memorials, he always said he had already discussed them with you, and so they were all approved;

sentences.zh: 且營奉先帝陵寢，而擅有遷易，幾誤大事。」

translations.literal: moreover, in constructing the late emperor's tomb he arbitrarily changed the site, nearly ruining a great undertaking."
translations.idiomatic: moreover, in constructing the late emperor's tomb he arbitrarily changed the site, nearly ruining a great undertaking."

sentences.zh: 拯等奏曰：「自先帝登遐，政事皆謂與允恭同議，稱得旨禁中。

translations.literal: Feng and the others memorialized: "Since the late emperor's passing, all state affairs have been jointly decided by Wei and Yungong, who claimed to have received approval within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and the others memorialized: "Since the late emperor's passing, all state affairs have been jointly decided by Wei and Yungong, who claimed to have received approval within the palace.

sentences.zh: 臣等莫辨虛實，賴聖神察其奸，此宗社之福也。」

translations.literal: We your ministers could not distinguish truth from falsehood. Thanks to Your Sagely insight into their treachery, this is a blessing for the altars of state."
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers could not distinguish truth from falsehood. Thanks to Your Sagely insight into their treachery, this is a blessing for the altars of state."

sentences.zh: 乃降謂太子少保、分司西京。

translations.literal: Wei was thereupon demoted to honorary grand tutor of the crown prince with duties at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was thereupon demoted to honorary grand tutor of the crown prince with duties at the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 故事，黜宰相皆降制，時欲亟行，止令拯等即殿廬召舍人草詞，仍榜朝堂，布諭天下。

translations.literal: By precedent, removal of a grand councilor was announced by edict. Because they wished to act quickly, they simply had Feng and the others summon a drafting secretary from the hall pavilion to compose the text, posted it in the court hall, and proclaimed it throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, removal of a grand councilor was announced by edict. Because they wished to act quickly, they simply had Feng and the others summon a drafting secretary from the hall pavilion to compose the text, posted it in the court hall, and proclaimed it throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 追其子珙、珝、玘、武一官，落珙館職。

translations.literal: His sons Gong, Xu, Qi, and Wu were each stripped of one rank, and Gong lost his academy post.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Gong, Xu, Qi, and Wu were each stripped of one rank, and Gong lost his academy post.

sentences.zh: 先是，女道士劉德妙者，嘗以巫師出入謂家。

translations.literal: Earlier, a female Daoist named Liu Demiao had once come and gone from Wei's household as a shaman.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, a female Daoist named Liu Demiao had once come and gone from Wei's household as a shaman.

sentences.zh: 謂敗，逮繫德妙，內侍鞫之。

translations.literal: When Wei fell, Demiao was arrested and interrogated by palace attendants.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei fell, Demiao was arrested and interrogated by palace attendants.

sentences.zh: 德妙通款，謂嘗教言：「若所為不過巫事，不若托言老君言禍福，足以動人。」

translations.literal: Demiao confessed fully. Wei had once instructed her: "If what you do is no more than shamanistic affairs, it is better to claim that the Old Lord speaks of fortune and misfortune — that is enough to move people."
translations.idiomatic: Demiao confessed fully. Wei had once instructed her: "If what you do is no more than shamanistic affairs, it is better to claim that the Old Lord speaks of fortune and misfortune — that is enough to move people."

sentences.zh: 於是即謂家設神像，夜醮於園中，允恭數至請禱。

translations.literal: Thereupon at Wei's residence an image of the deity was set up, and night rituals were performed in the garden. Yungong came repeatedly to request prayers.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon at Wei's residence an image of the deity was set up, and night rituals were performed in the garden. Yungong came repeatedly to request prayers.

sentences.zh: 及帝崩，引入禁中。

translations.literal: When the emperor died, she was brought into the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor died, she was brought into the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 又因穿地得龜蛇，令德妙持入內，紿言出其家山洞中。

translations.literal: Also, by digging the ground they obtained a tortoise and serpent. Wei had Demiao carry them into the palace and falsely claimed they had come from a mountain cave at his home.
translations.idiomatic: Also, by digging the ground they obtained a tortoise and serpent. Wei had Demiao carry them into the palace and falsely claimed they had come from a mountain cave at his home.

sentences.zh: 仍復教云：「上即問若，所事何知為老君，第云『相公非凡人，當知之』。」

translations.literal: He further instructed her: "When the emperor asks you how you know this is the Old Lord, simply say, 'The grand councilor is no ordinary man — he ought to know.'"
translations.idiomatic: He further instructed her: "When the emperor asks you how you know this is the Old Lord, simply say, 'The grand councilor is no ordinary man — he ought to know.'"

sentences.zh: 謂又作頌，題曰「混元皇帝賜德妙」，語涉妖誕。

translations.literal: Wei also composed a eulogy titled "The Primordial Emperor Bestows Favor upon Demiao," whose language touched on sorcery and fabrication.
translations.idiomatic: Wei also composed a eulogy titled "The Primordial Emperor Bestows Favor upon Demiao," whose language touched on sorcery and fabrication.

sentences.zh: 遂貶崖州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: He was thereupon demoted to registrar in Yazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was thereupon demoted to registrar in Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 諸子並勒停。

translations.literal: All his sons were ordered to cease holding office.
translations.idiomatic: All his sons were ordered to cease holding office.

sentences.zh: 玘又坐與德妙奸，除名，配隸復州。

translations.literal: Qi was further punished for adultery with Demiao, was struck from the rolls, and was assigned to serve in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qi was further punished for adultery with Demiao, was struck from the rolls, and was assigned to serve in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 籍其家，得四方賂遺，不可勝紀。

translations.literal: His household was inventoried, and bribes received from all quarters were found in numbers beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: His household was inventoried, and bribes received from all quarters were found in numbers beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 其弟誦、說、諫悉降黜。

translations.literal: His younger brothers Song, Shuo, and Jian were all demoted and removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brothers Song, Shuo, and Jian were all demoted and removed from office.

sentences.zh: 坐謂罷者，自參知政事任中正而下十數人。

translations.literal: Those removed from office because of Wei numbered more than ten, from Participant in State Affairs Ren Zhongzheng downward.
translations.idiomatic: Those removed from office because of Wei numbered more than ten, from vice grand councilor Ren Zhongzheng downward.

sentences.zh: 在崖州逾三年，徙雷州，又五年，徙道州。

translations.literal: After more than three years in Yazhou he was transferred to Leizhou; after another five years he was transferred to Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: After more than three years in Yazhou he was transferred to Leizhou; after another five years he was transferred to Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 明道中，授秘書監致仕，居光州，卒。

translations.literal: During the Mingdao era he was granted retirement as director of the Imperial Library, lived in Guangzhou, and died.
translations.idiomatic: During the Mingdao era he was granted retirement as director of the Imperial Library, lived in Guangzhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 詔賜錢十萬、絹百匹。

translations.literal: An edict granted one hundred thousand in cash and one hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted one hundred thousand in cash and one hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 謂機敏有智謀，憸狡過人，文字累數千百言，一覽輒誦。

translations.literal: Wei was quick-witted and resourceful, more cunning and sly than others. Texts running to thousands of characters he could read once and recite.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was quick-witted and resourceful, more cunning and sly than others. Texts running to thousands of characters he could read once and recite.

sentences.zh: 在三司，案牘繁委，吏久難解者，一言判之，眾皆釋然。

translations.literal: In the Three Departments, when documents piled up in complexity and clerks had long been unable to resolve them, he would decide them in a single sentence and all would be relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the Three Departments, when documents piled up in complexity and clerks had long been unable to resolve them, he would decide them in a single sentence and all would be relieved.

sentences.zh: 善談笑，尤喜為詩，至於圖畫、博奕、音律，無不洞曉。

translations.literal: He was skilled in conversation and wit, especially fond of composing poetry, and as for painting, games, and music, there was none he did not thoroughly understand.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled in conversation and wit, especially fond of composing poetry, and as for painting, games, and music, there was none he did not thoroughly understand.

sentences.zh: 每休沐會賓客，盡陳之，聽人人自便，而謂從容應接於其間，莫能出其意者。

translations.literal: Whenever he rested from office and gathered guests, he displayed all of these and let each person amuse himself as he wished, while Wei calmly received them throughout — none could get the better of him.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he rested from office and gathered guests, he displayed all of these and let each person amuse himself as he wished, while Wei calmly received them throughout — none could get the better of him.

sentences.zh: 真宗朝營造宮觀，奏祥異之事，多謂與王欽若發之。

translations.literal: During the Zhenzong era, construction of palaces and temples and memorials reporting auspicious and strange events were largely initiated by Wei together with Wang Qinruo.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenzong era, construction of palaces and temples and memorials reporting auspicious and strange events were largely initiated by Wei together with Wang Qinruo.

sentences.zh: 初，議營昭應宮，料功須二十五年，謂令以夜繼晝，每繪一壁給二燭，七年乃成。

translations.literal: At first, when construction of the Zhaoying Palace was discussed, the labor was estimated to require twenty-five years. Wei ordered work to continue day and night, giving two candles for each wall painted, and it was completed in seven years.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when construction of the Zhaoying Palace was discussed, the labor was estimated to require twenty-five years. Wei ordered work to continue day and night, giving two candles for each wall painted, and it was completed in seven years.

sentences.zh: 真宗崩，議草遺制，軍國事兼取皇太后處分，謂乃增以「權」字。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhenzong died, in drafting the final edict it was proposed that military and state affairs be jointly disposed of by the empress dowager. Wei added the character for "provisional."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong died, in drafting the final edict it was proposed that military and state affairs be jointly disposed of by the empress dowager. Wei added the character for "provisional."

sentences.zh: 及太后稱制，又議月進錢充宮掖之用，由是太后深惡之，因雷允恭遂並錄謂前後欺罔事竄之。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager assumed regency, there was further discussion of monthly cash payments to supply the inner palace. For this reason the empress dowager deeply hated him, and because of Lei Yungong she recorded all of Wei's acts of deception before and after and had him exiled.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager assumed regency, there was further discussion of monthly cash payments to supply the inner palace. For this reason the empress dowager deeply hated him, and because of Lei Yungong she recorded all of Wei's acts of deception before and after and had him exiled.

sentences.zh: 在貶所，專事浮屠因果之說，其所著詩並文亦數萬言。

translations.literal: In his place of exile he devoted himself to Buddhist teachings on cause and effect. The poetry and prose he wrote also ran to tens of thousands of words.
translations.idiomatic: In his place of exile he devoted himself to Buddhist teachings on cause and effect. The poetry and prose he wrote also ran to tens of thousands of words.

sentences.zh: 家寓洛陽，嘗為書自克責，敘國厚恩，戒家人毋輒怨望，遣人致於洛守劉燁，祈付其家。

translations.literal: His family lived in Luoyang. He once wrote a letter reproaching himself, recounting the state's great kindness, admonishing his family not to harbor resentment, and sent a messenger to deliver it to Liu Ye, prefect of Luoyang, asking that it be passed to his household.
translations.idiomatic: His family lived in Luoyang. He once wrote a letter reproaching himself, recounting the state's great kindness, admonishing his family not to harbor resentment, and sent a messenger to deliver it to Liu Ye, prefect of Luoyang, asking that it be passed to his household.

sentences.zh: 戒使者伺燁會眾僚時達之，燁得書不敢私，即以聞。

translations.literal: He instructed the messenger to wait until Ye was meeting with his staff before delivering it. Ye, upon receiving the letter, dared not keep it private and reported it at once.
translations.idiomatic: He instructed the messenger to wait until Ye was meeting with his staff before delivering it. Ye, upon receiving the letter, dared not keep it private and reported it at once.

sentences.zh: 帝見感惻，遂徙雷州，亦出於揣摩也。

translations.literal: When the emperor read it he was moved with compassion and transferred him to Leizhou — this too arose from calculation.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor read it he was moved with compassion and transferred him to Leizhou — this too arose from calculation.

sentences.zh: 謂初通判饒州，遇異人曰：「君貌類李讚皇。」

translations.literal: When Wei first served as military prefect of Raozhou, he met a strange man who said: "Your appearance resembles that of Li Zanhuang."
translations.idiomatic: When Wei first served as military prefect of Raozhou, he met a strange man who said: "Your appearance resembles that of Li Zanhuang."

sentences.zh: 既而曰：「讚皇不及也。」

translations.literal: Then he added: "But Zanhuang does not compare to you."
translations.idiomatic: Then he added: "But Zanhuang does not compare to you."

sentences.zh: 夏竦，字子喬，江州德安人。

translations.literal: Xia Song, styled Ziqiao, was a native of De'an in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Song, courtesy name Ziqiao, came from De'an in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 父承皓，太平興國初，上《平晉策》，補右侍禁，隸大名府。

translations.literal: His father Chenghao, at the beginning of the Taiping xingguo era, submitted "A Plan for the Pacification of Jin," was appointed right palace guard, and was attached to Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chenghao, at the beginning of the Taiping xingguo era, submitted "A Plan for the Pacification of Jin," was appointed right palace guard, and was attached to Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 契丹內寇，承皓繇間道發兵，夜與契丹遇，力戰死之，贈崇儀使，錄竦為潤州丹陽縣主簿。

translations.literal: When the Khitan invaded, Chenghao dispatched troops by a hidden route, encountered the Khitan at night, fought fiercely, and died in battle. He was posthumously honored as commissioner of ceremonial guard, and Song was given appointment as registrar of Danyang County in Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan invaded, Chenghao dispatched troops by a hidden route, encountered the Khitan at night, fought fiercely, and died in battle. He was posthumously honored as commissioner of ceremonial guard, and Song was given appointment as registrar of Danyang County in Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 竦資性明敏，好學，自經史、百家、陰陽、律曆，外至佛老之書，無不通曉。

translations.literal: Song was by nature bright and keen, fond of learning. From the classics and histories, the hundred schools, yin-yang lore, and calendrical astronomy, outward even to Buddhist and Daoist texts, there was none he did not thoroughly understand.
translations.idiomatic: Song was by nature bright and keen, fond of learning. From the classics and histories, the hundred schools, yin-yang lore, and calendrical astronomy, outward even to Buddhist and Daoist texts, there was none he did not thoroughly understand.

sentences.zh: 為文章，典雅藻麗。

translations.literal: In writing essays he was elegant, refined, and richly ornamented.
translations.idiomatic: In writing essays he was elegant, refined, and richly ornamented.

sentences.zh: 舉賢良方正，擢光祿寺丞、通判台州。

translations.literal: He was recommended as worthy and upright, was promoted to vice director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and made military prefect of Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was recommended as worthy and upright, was promoted to vice director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and made military prefect of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 召直集賢院，為國史編修官、判三司都磨勘司，累遷右正言。

translations.literal: He was summoned to serve at the Hall of Assembled Worthies, appointed compiler of the national history and assigned to the Three Departments General Audit Office, and was promoted in succession to right remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve at the Hall of Assembled Worthies, appointed compiler of the national history and assigned to the Three Departments General Audit Office, and was promoted in succession to right remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 帝幸亳州，為東京留守推官。

translations.literal: When the emperor visited Bozhou, Song served as deputy magistrate for the Eastern Capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Bozhou, Song served as deputy magistrate for the Eastern Capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 仁宗初封慶國公，王旦數言竦材，命教書資善堂。

translations.literal: When Renzong was first enfeoffed as Duke of Qing, Wang Dan repeatedly spoke of Song's talent, and he was ordered to teach at the Hall of Excellent Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong was first enfeoffed as Duke of Qing, Wang Dan repeatedly spoke of Song's talent, and he was ordered to teach at the Hall of Excellent Virtue.

sentences.zh: 未幾，同修起居注，為玉清昭應宮判官兼領景靈宮、會真觀事，遷尚書禮部員外郎、知制誥。

translations.literal: Before long he jointly compiled the Daily Record, served as judge of the Yujing Zhaoying Palace with concurrent charge of the Jingling Palace and Huizhen Abbey, and was promoted to outer-section secretary in the Ministry of Rites and drafting secretary for imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he jointly compiled the Daily Record, served as judge of the Yujing Zhaoying Palace with concurrent charge of the Jingling Palace and Huizhen Abbey, and was promoted to outer-section secretary in the Ministry of Rites and drafting secretary for imperial edicts.

sentences.zh: 史成，遷戶部。

translations.literal: When the history was completed he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When the history was completed he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 景靈宮成，遷禮部郎中。

translations.literal: When the Jingling Palace was completed he was promoted to bureau director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jingling Palace was completed he was promoted to bureau director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 竦娶楊氏，楊亦工筆劄，有鉤距。

translations.literal: Song married a Lady Yang, who was also skilled in letters and had a sharp and calculating mind.
translations.idiomatic: Song married a Lady Yang, who was also skilled in letters and had a sharp and calculating mind.

sentences.zh: 及竦顯，多內寵，浸與楊不諧，楊悍妒，即與弟胃疏竦陰事，竊出訟之，又竦母與楊母相詬詈，偕訴開封府，府以事聞，下御史臺置劾，左遷職方員外郎、知黃州。

translations.literal: When Song rose to prominence he took many inner-palace favorites, and relations with Yang gradually soured. Yang was fierce and jealous. She joined with her younger brother Wei in memorializing Song's secret affairs, stole out to sue him, and Song's mother and Yang's mother also exchanged curses. Together they sued at the Kaifeng prefectural office. The office reported the matter, and the case was referred to the Censorate for investigation. Song was demoted to outer-section secretary in the Ministry of War and made prefect of Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Song rose to prominence he took many inner-palace favorites, and relations with Yang gradually soured. Yang was fierce and jealous. She joined with her younger brother Wei in memorializing Song's secret affairs, stole out to sue him, and Song's mother and Yang's mother also exchanged curses. Together they sued at the Kaifeng prefectural office. The office reported the matter, and the case was referred to the Censorate for investigation. Song was demoted to outer-section secretary in the Ministry of War and made prefect of Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 後二年，徙鄧州，又徙襄州。

translations.literal: Two years later he was transferred to Dengzhou, then again to Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he was transferred to Dengzhou, then again to Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 屬歲饑，大發公廩，不足，竦又勸率州大姓，使出粟，得二萬斛，用全活者四十餘萬人。

translations.literal: When famine struck that year, he greatly opened the public granaries, but the supply was insufficient. Song also urged the great clans of the prefecture to contribute grain, obtaining twenty thousand hu, by which more than four hundred thousand people were preserved alive.
translations.idiomatic: When famine struck that year, he greatly opened the public granaries, but the supply was insufficient. Song also urged the great clans of the prefecture to contribute grain, obtaining twenty thousand hu, by which more than four hundred thousand people were preserved alive.

sentences.zh: 仁宗即位，遷戶部郎中，徙壽、安、洪三州。

translations.literal: When Renzong ascended the throne, Song was promoted to bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred through the three prefectures of Shou, An, and Hong.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong ascended the throne, Song was promoted to bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred through the three prefectures of Shou, An, and Hong.

sentences.zh: 洪俗尚鬼，多巫覡惑民，竦索部中得千餘家，敕還農業，毀其淫祠以聞。

translations.literal: The customs of Hongzhou favored spirits, and many shamans deluded the people. Song searched his jurisdiction and found more than a thousand households, ordered them back to agriculture, destroyed their illicit shrines, and reported the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The customs of Hongzhou favored spirits, and many shamans deluded the people. Song searched his jurisdiction and found more than a thousand households, ordered them back to agriculture, destroyed their illicit shrines, and reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 詔江、浙以南悉禁絕之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that this be entirely forbidden south of the Jiang and Zhe regions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that this be entirely forbidden south of the Jiang and Zhe regions.

sentences.zh: 竦材術過人，急於進取，喜交結，任數術，傾側反覆，世以為奸邪。

translations.literal: Song's talent and skill surpassed others. He was eager to advance, fond of forming connections, relied on stratagems, and shifted and reversed himself — the world regarded him as treacherous and corrupt.
translations.idiomatic: Song's talent and skill surpassed others. He was eager to advance, fond of forming connections, relied on stratagems, and shifted and reversed himself — the world regarded him as treacherous and corrupt.

sentences.zh: 當太后臨朝，嘗上疏乞與修《真宗實錄》，不報。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager held court, he once submitted a memorial requesting to participate in compiling the Veritable Records of Zhenzong, but received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager held court, he once submitted a memorial requesting to participate in compiling the Veritable Records of Zhenzong, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 既而丁母憂，潛至京師，依中人張懷德為內助，宰相王欽若雅善竦，因左右之，遂起復知制誥，為景靈判官、判集賢院，以左司郎中為翰林學士、勾當三班院兼侍讀學士、龍圖閣學士，又兼譯經潤文官。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, while in mourning for his mother, he secretly went to the capital, relied on the palace attendant Zhang Huai'de as an inner supporter, and because Grand Councilor Wang Qinruo had long been on good terms with Song and promoted him from the side, he was recalled from mourning as drafting secretary for imperial edicts, made judge of the Jingling Palace and judge of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, appointed Hanlin academician with charge of the Three Classes Office and concurrent reader-in-waiting academician and academician of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, and also served as polishing editor for scripture translation.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, while in mourning for his mother, he secretly went to the capital, relied on the palace attendant Zhang Huai'de as an inner supporter, and because Grand Councilor Wang Qinruo had long been on good terms with Song and promoted him from the side, he was recalled from mourning as drafting secretary for imperial edicts, made judge of the Jingling Palace and judge of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, appointed Hanlin academician with charge of the Three Classes Office and concurrent reader-in-waiting academician and academician of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, and also served as polishing editor for scripture translation.

sentences.zh: 遷諫議大夫，為樞密副使、修國史，遷給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to censor-in-chief, made deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and compiler of the national history, and promoted to supervisory censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor-in-chief, made deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and compiler of the national history, and promoted to supervisory censor.

sentences.zh: 初，武臣賞罰無法，吏得高下為奸，竦為集前比，著為定例，事皆按比而行。

translations.literal: At first, rewards and punishments for military officers had no fixed standard, and clerks could manipulate them for fraud. Song collected earlier precedents, set them down as fixed regulations, and all matters were handled according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: At first, rewards and punishments for military officers had no fixed standard, and clerks could manipulate them for fraud. Song collected earlier precedents, set them down as fixed regulations, and all matters were handled according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 改參知政事、祥源觀使。

translations.literal: He was changed to participant in state affairs and commissioner of the Xiangyuan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to vice grand councilor and commissioner of the Xiangyuan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 增設賢良等六科，復百官轉對，置理檢使，皆竦所發。

translations.literal: The addition of six categories including Worthy and Upright, the restoration of rotating memorials by all officials, and the establishment of the commissioner for review of petitions were all initiated by Song.
translations.idiomatic: The addition of six categories including Worthy and Upright, the restoration of rotating memorials by all officials, and the establishment of the commissioner for review of petitions were all initiated by Song.

sentences.zh: 與宰相呂夷簡不相能，復為樞密副使，遷刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was incompatible with Grand Councilor Lü Yijian, was again made deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was promoted to vice minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was incompatible with Grand Councilor Lü Yijian, was again made deputy director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was promoted to vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 史成，進兵部，尋進尚書左丞。

translations.literal: When the history was completed he was advanced to the Ministry of War, and soon afterward promoted to left vice director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When the history was completed he was advanced to the Ministry of War, and soon afterward promoted to left vice director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 太后崩，罷為禮部尚書、知襄州，改潁州。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager died he was removed to minister of rites and prefect of Xiangzhou, then transferred to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager died he was removed to minister of rites and prefect of Xiangzhou, then transferred to Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 京東薦饑，徙青州兼安撫使。

translations.literal: When famine recurred in eastern capital circuit, he was transferred to Qingzhou with concurrent appointment as pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When famine recurred in eastern capital circuit, he was transferred to Qingzhou with concurrent appointment as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 逾年，罷安撫，遷刑部尚書、徙應天府。

translations.literal: After a year he was removed from the pacification commission, promoted to minister of justice, and transferred to Yingtian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was removed from the pacification commission, promoted to minister of justice, and transferred to Yingtian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 寶元初，以戶部尚書入為三司使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoyuan he entered the capital as minister of revenue to serve as commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Baoyuan he entered the capital as minister of revenue to serve as commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 趙元昊反，拜奉寧軍節度使、知永興軍，聽便宜行事。

translations.literal: When Zhao Yuanhao rebelled, Song was appointed military commissioner of the Fengning Army and prefect of Yongxing Circuit, with authority to act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Yuanhao rebelled, Song was appointed military commissioner of the Fengning Army and prefect of Yongxing Circuit, with authority to act as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 徙忠武軍節度使、知涇州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Zhongwu Army and prefect of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Zhongwu Army and prefect of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 還，判永興軍兼陝西經略安撫招討，進宣徽南院使。

translations.literal: Upon returning he was assigned to Yongxing Circuit with concurrent authority as frontier commissioner for pacification and punitive action in Shaanxi, and was promoted to commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Upon returning he was assigned to Yongxing Circuit with concurrent authority as frontier commissioner for pacification and punitive action in Shaanxi, and was promoted to commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 與陳執中論兵事不合，詔徙屯鄜州。

translations.literal: He disagreed with Chen Zhizhong on military affairs, and an edict ordered him transferred to garrison at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He clashed with Chen Zhizhong over military affairs, and an edict ordered him transferred to garrison at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，竦在涇州，朝廷遣龐籍就計事。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Song was at Jingzhou, the court dispatched Pang Ji to consult with him on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Song was at Jingzhou, the court dispatched Pang Ji to consult with him on frontier strategy.

sentences.zh: 竦上奏曰：

translations.literal: Song memorialized, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Song memorialized as follows:

sentences.zh: 「頃者繼遷逃背，屢寇朔方。

translations.literal: "Recently Jiqian rebelled and fled, repeatedly raiding Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: "Recently Li Jiqian rebelled and fled, repeatedly raiding Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 至道初，洛苑使白守榮等率重兵護糧四十萬，遇寇浦洛河，糧卒並沒，守榮僅以身免。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, the Luoyuan commissioner Bai Shourong and others led a large force escorting four hundred thousand units of grain. They encountered bandits at the Pulu River; grain and troops were all lost, and Shourong barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, the Luoyuan commissioner Bai Shourong and others led a large force escorting four hundred thousand units of grain. They encountered bandits at the Pulu River; grain and troops were all lost, and Shourong barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 呂端始欲發兵，由麟府、鄜延、環慶三路趣平夏，襲其巢穴，太宗難之。

translations.literal: Lü Duan at first wished to dispatch troops by the three routes of Lin-fu, Fuyan, and Huanqing toward Pingxia to strike their lair, but Emperor Taizong found this difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Duan at first wished to dispatch troops by the three routes of Lin-fu, Fuyan, and Huanqing toward Pingxia to strike their lair, but Emperor Taizong found this difficult.

sentences.zh: 後命李繼隆、丁罕、範廷召、王超、張守恩五路入討。

translations.literal: Later he ordered Li Jilong, Ding Han, Fan Tingzhao, Wang Chao, and Zhang Shou'en to enter on five routes to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Later he ordered Li Jilong, Ding Han, Fan Tingzhao, Wang Chao, and Zhang Shou'en to invade on five routes.

sentences.zh: 繼隆與罕合兵，行旬日，不見賊；

translations.literal: Jilong and Han combined forces and marched for ten days without sighting the enemy;
translations.idiomatic: Jilong and Han combined forces and marched for ten days without sighting the enemy;

sentences.zh: 守恩見賊不擊；

translations.literal: Shou'en saw the enemy but did not attack;
translations.idiomatic: Shou'en saw the enemy but did not attack;

sentences.zh: 超及廷召至烏白池，以諸將失期，士卒困敝，相繼引還。

translations.literal: Chao and Tingzhao reached Wubai Pond. Because the generals had missed their rendezvous and the troops were exhausted, they withdrew one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Chao and Tingzhao reached Wubai Pond. Because the generals had missed their rendezvous and the troops were exhausted, they withdrew one after another.

sentences.zh: 時繼遷當繼捧入朝之後，曹光實掩襲之餘，遁逃窮蹙，而猶累歲不能剿滅。

translations.literal: At that time Jiqian, after Jipeng had entered court and after Cao Guangshi's surprise attack, was fleeing in desperate straits, yet for years he could not be exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jiqian, after Jipeng had submitted at court and after Cao Guangshi's surprise attack, was fleeing in desperate straits, yet for years he could not be exterminated.

sentences.zh: 先皇帝鑒追討之敝，戒疆吏謹烽候、嚴卒乘，來即驅逐之，去無追捕也。

translations.literal: The late emperor, observing the defects of pursuit and attack, admonished frontier officials to be vigilant at beacon stations and strict with troops and mounts: when the enemy came, drive them off; when they left, do not pursue.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor, observing the defects of pursuit and attack, admonished frontier officials to be vigilant at beacon stations and strict with troops and mounts: when the enemy came, drive them off; when they left, do not pursue.

sentences.zh: 然拓跋之境，自靈武陷沒之後，銀、綏割棄已來，假朝廷威靈，其所役屬者不過河外小羌爾。

translations.literal: Yet the territory of the Tuoba, since the fall of Lingwu and the abandonment of Yin and Sui, relying on the court's authority, had under its command no more than the small Qiang tribes beyond the river.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Tuoba realm, since the fall of Lingwu and the abandonment of Yin and Sui, relying on the court's authority, had under its command no more than the small Qiang tribes beyond the river.

sentences.zh: 況德明、元昊相繼猖獗，以繼遷窮蹙，比元昊富實，勢可知也。

translations.literal: Moreover, Deming and Yuanhao succeeded one another in rampant aggression. Compared with Jiqian in desperate straits, Yuanhao is wealthy and strong — the situation is clear.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Deming and Yuanhao succeeded one another in rampant aggression. Compared with Jiqian in desperate straits, Yuanhao is wealthy and strong — the situation is clear.

sentences.zh: 以先朝累勝之士，較當今關東之兵，勇怯可知也。

translations.literal: Comparing the repeatedly victorious troops of the previous reign with today's eastern capital troops, their courage and timidity are clear.
translations.idiomatic: Comparing the repeatedly victorious troops of the previous reign with today's eastern capital troops, their courage and timidity are clear.

sentences.zh: 以興國習戰之帥，方沿邊未試之將，工拙可知也。

translations.literal: Comparing the battle-hardened commanders of the Xingguo era with the untested generals now on the frontier, their skill and clumsiness are clear.
translations.idiomatic: Comparing the battle-hardened commanders of the Xingguo era with the untested generals now on the frontier, their skill and clumsiness are clear.

sentences.zh: 繼遷竄伏平夏，元昊窟穴河外，地勢可知也。

translations.literal: Jiqian hid in Pingxia; Yuanhao nests beyond the river — the terrain is clear.
translations.idiomatic: Jiqian hid in Pingxia; Yuanhao nests beyond the river — the terrain is clear.

sentences.zh: 若分兵深入，糗糧不支，師行賊境，利於速戰。

translations.literal: If troops are divided and sent deep in, provisions will not suffice. An army marching in enemy territory favors swift battle.
translations.idiomatic: If troops are divided and sent deep in, provisions will not suffice. An army marching in enemy territory favors swift battle.

sentences.zh: 儻進則賊避其鋒，退則敵躡其後，老師費糧，深可虞也。

translations.literal: If we advance, the enemy will avoid our edge; if we retreat, the foe will follow at our heels. A weary army consuming grain — this is deeply to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: If we advance, the enemy will avoid our edge; if we retreat, the foe will follow at our heels. A weary army consuming grain — this is deeply to be feared.

sentences.zh: 若窮其巢穴，須涉大河，長舟巨艦，非倉卒可具也。

translations.literal: If we are to reach their lair, we must cross the great river. Long boats and great ships cannot be prepared in haste.
translations.idiomatic: If we are to reach their lair, we must cross the great river. Long boats and great ships cannot be prepared in haste.

sentences.zh: 若浮囊挽梗，聯絡而進，我師半渡，賊乘勢掩擊，未知何謀可以捍禦？

translations.literal: If we use floats and tow logs and advance in linked formation, and our army is half across when the enemy seizes the moment to strike, what plan could ward them off?
translations.idiomatic: If we use floats and tow logs and advance in linked formation, and our army is half across when the enemy seizes the moment to strike, what plan could ward them off?

sentences.zh: 臣以為不較主客之利，不計攻守之便，而議追討者，非良策也。」

translations.literal: Your subject believes that to discuss pursuit and attack without weighing the advantages of host and guest, without calculating the conveniences of offense and defense, is not a good strategy."
translations.idiomatic: Your subject believes that to discuss pursuit and attack without weighing the advantages of host and guest, without calculating the conveniences of offense and defense, is not a good strategy."

sentences.zh: 因條上十事。

translations.literal: He thereupon submitted ten items in detail.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon submitted ten detailed proposals.

sentences.zh: 時邊臣多議征討，朝廷鄉之，而竦言出師非便。

translations.literal: At that time many frontier officials discussed punitive campaigns, and the court inclined toward them, but Song said that dispatching troops was inexpedient.
translations.idiomatic: At that time many frontier officials discussed punitive campaigns, and the court inclined toward them, but Song argued that dispatching troops was inexpedient.

sentences.zh: 既而詔以涇原、鄜延兩路兵進討，會元昊稍求納款，范仲淹請留鄜延兵，由是涇原兵亦不行。

translations.literal: Soon afterward an edict ordered troops of the Jingyuan and Fuyan routes to advance in attack. It happened that Yuanhao was gradually seeking to submit, Fan Zhongyan requested that the Fuyan troops be retained, and for this reason the Jingyuan troops also did not march.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward an edict ordered troops of the Jingyuan and Fuyan routes to advance in attack. It happened that Yuanhao was gradually seeking to submit, Fan Zhongyan requested that the Fuyan troops be retained, and for this reason the Jingyuan troops also did not march.

sentences.zh: 中國之師，卒不出塞。

translations.literal: The armies of the Middle Kingdom in the end did not cross the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The armies of the Middle Kingdom in the end did not cross the frontier.

sentences.zh: 竦上十事：一、教習強弩以為奇兵；

translations.literal: Song submitted ten items: first, drill powerful crossbows to serve as special troops;
translations.idiomatic: Song submitted ten items: first, drill powerful crossbows to serve as special troops;

sentences.zh: 二、羈縻屬羌以為藩籬；

translations.literal: second, keep dependent Qiang tribes in submission to serve as a barrier;
translations.idiomatic: second, keep dependent Qiang tribes in submission to serve as a barrier;

sentences.zh: 三、詔唃廝囉父子並力破賊；

translations.literal: third, order Gusiluo and his son to join forces to destroy the bandits;
translations.idiomatic: third, order Gusiluo and his son to join forces to destroy the bandits;

sentences.zh: 四、度地形險易遠近、砦柵多少、軍士勇怯，而增減屯兵；

translations.literal: fourth, assess terrain for difficulty, ease, distance, and nearness, the number of stockades and forts, and the courage or timidity of troops, and increase or decrease garrison forces accordingly;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, assess terrain for difficulty, ease, distance, and nearness, the number of stockades and forts, and the courage or timidity of troops, and increase or decrease garrison forces accordingly;

sentences.zh: 五、詔諸路互相應援；

translations.literal: fifth, order the various routes to support one another;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, order the various routes to support one another;

sentences.zh: 六、募土人為兵，州各一二千人，以代東兵；

translations.literal: sixth, recruit local men as soldiers, one or two thousand per prefecture, to replace eastern capital troops;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, recruit local men as soldiers, one or two thousand per prefecture, to replace eastern capital troops;

sentences.zh: 七、增置弓手、壯丁、獵戶以備城守；

translations.literal: seventh, add archers, strong youths, and hunters to prepare for city defense;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, add archers, strong youths, and hunters to prepare for city defense;

sentences.zh: 八、並邊小砦，毋積芻糧，賊攻急，則棄小砦入保大砦，以完兵力；

translations.literal: eighth, consolidate small frontier stockades, do not accumulate fodder and grain; when the enemy attacks urgently, abandon small stockades and withdraw into large ones to preserve fighting strength;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, consolidate small frontier stockades, do not accumulate fodder and grain; when the enemy attacks urgently, abandon small stockades and withdraw into large ones to preserve fighting strength;

sentences.zh: 九、關中民坐累若過誤者，許人入粟贖罪，銅一斤為粟五斗，以贍邊計；

translations.literal: ninth, for people of Guanzhong implicated by association or for minor offenses, permit payment of grain to redeem guilt, one pound of copper equaling five dou of grain, to supply frontier needs;
translations.idiomatic: ninth, for people of Guanzhong implicated by association or for minor offenses, permit payment of grain to redeem guilt, one pound of copper equaling five dou of grain, to supply frontier needs;

sentences.zh: 十、損並邊冗兵、冗官及減騎軍，以舒饋運。

translations.literal: tenth, reduce redundant troops and officials on the frontier and cut cavalry forces to ease transport burdens.
translations.idiomatic: tenth, reduce redundant troops and officials on the frontier and cut cavalry forces to ease transport burdens.

sentences.zh: 當時頗采用之。

translations.literal: At the time many of these were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: At the time many of these were adopted.

sentences.zh: 其募土人為兵，令下而楊偕奏言：「西兵比繼遷時十增七八，縣官困於供億，今州復益一二千人，則歲費不貲。

translations.literal: As for recruiting local men as soldiers, when the order was issued Yang Jie memorialized: "Western troops have increased seven or eight tenths compared with the time of Jiqian. The state treasury is strained by supply costs. If each prefecture adds another one or two thousand men, annual expense will be beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: As for recruiting local men as soldiers, when the order was issued Yang Jie memorialized: "Western troops have increased seven or eight tenths compared with the time of Jiqian. The state treasury is strained by supply costs. If each prefecture adds another one or two thousand men, annual expense will be beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 若訓習士卒，使之精銳，選任將帥，求之方略，自然以寡擊眾，以一當百矣。

translations.literal: If troops are trained and made sharp, if commanders are selected and assigned, and if strategy is sought, naturally one may strike many with few and match one against a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: If troops are trained and made sharp, if commanders are selected and assigned, and if strategy is sought, naturally one may strike many with few and match one against a hundred.

sentences.zh: 竦云「土兵訓練可代東兵」，此虛言也。

translations.literal: Song says that 'local troops, once trained, can replace eastern capital troops' — this is empty talk.
translations.idiomatic: Song says that 'local troops, once trained, can replace eastern capital troops' — this is empty talk.

sentences.zh: 自德明納款以來，東兵猶不可代，況今日乎？」

translations.literal: Since Deming submitted, eastern capital troops still could not be replaced — how much less today?"
translations.idiomatic: Since Deming submitted, eastern capital troops still could not be replaced — how much less today?"

sentences.zh: 朝廷下竦議，竦奏：「陝西防秋之敝，無甚東兵，不慣登陟，不耐寒暑，驕懦相習，廩給至厚。

translations.literal: The court referred Song's proposal for discussion. Song memorialized: "The defect in Shaanxi frontier defense lies above all in eastern capital troops: unaccustomed to climbing, unable to endure heat and cold, habitually arrogant and timid, and receiving extremely generous rations.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred Song's proposal for discussion. Song memorialized: "The defect in Shaanxi frontier defense lies above all in eastern capital troops: unaccustomed to climbing, unable to endure heat and cold, habitually arrogant and timid, and receiving extremely generous rations.

sentences.zh: 土兵便習，各護鄉土，山川道路，彼皆素知，歲省芻糧鉅萬。

translations.literal: Local troops are accustomed to the terrain, each defending his native place. Mountains, rivers, and roads — they all know them well. Each year fodder and grain in the tens of thousands would be saved.
translations.idiomatic: Local troops are accustomed to the terrain, each defending his native place. Mountains, rivers, and roads — they all know them well. Each year fodder and grain in the tens of thousands would be saved.

sentences.zh: 且收聚小民，免饑餓為盜，代兵東歸，以衛京師，萬世利也。

translations.literal: Moreover, gathering the common people would spare them hunger and turning to banditry; replacing troops and sending eastern capital soldiers home to guard the capital would be a benefit for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, gathering the common people would spare them hunger and turning to banditry; replacing troops and sending eastern capital soldiers home to guard the capital would be a benefit for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 偕欲以寡擊眾，殆虛言也。」

translations.literal: Jie's wish to strike many with few is probably empty talk."
translations.idiomatic: Jie's wish to strike many with few is probably empty talk."

sentences.zh: 偕復奏云：「自古將帥深入殊庭，霍去病止將輕騎八百，直棄大將軍數百里赴利，斬捕過當；

translations.literal: Jie memorialized again: "From antiquity, when generals penetrated deep into foreign lands, Huo Qubing led only eight hundred light cavalry, abandoning the grand general several hundred li to seize advantage, and his kills and captures exceeded all measure;
translations.idiomatic: Jie memorialized again: "From antiquity, when generals penetrated deep into foreign lands, Huo Qubing led only eight hundred light cavalry, abandoning the grand general several hundred li to seize advantage, and his kills and captures exceeded all measure;

sentences.zh: 又將萬騎逾烏盭，討遫仆，涉狐奴，曆五王國，過焉支山千有餘里，合兵鏖皋蘭下，殺折蘭王、盧侯王，執昆邪王子，收休屠祭天金人。

translations.literal: again he led ten thousand horsemen across Wuji, attacked Chupu, crossed Hunu, passed through five kingdoms, went more than a thousand li beyond Yanzhi Mountain, combined forces and fought fiercely below Gaolan, killed the kings of Zhelan and Luhou, captured the prince of Kunye, and seized the golden man with which Xiutu sacrificed to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: again he led ten thousand horsemen across Wuji, attacked Chupu, crossed Hunu, passed through five kingdoms, went more than a thousand li beyond Yanzhi Mountain, combined forces and fought fiercely below Gaolan, killed the kings of Zhelan and Luhou, captured the prince of Kunye, and seized the golden man with which Xiutu sacrificed to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 趙充國亦以萬騎破先零。

translations.literal: Zhao Chongguo also broke the Xianling with ten thousand horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Chongguo also broke the Xianling with ten thousand horsemen.

sentences.zh: 李靖以驍騎三千破突厥，又以精騎一萬至陰山，斬首千餘級，俘男女十餘萬，擒頡利以獻。

translations.literal: Li Jing broke the Turks with three thousand fierce cavalry, and again with ten thousand elite horsemen reached Yinshan, beheaded more than a thousand, captured more than one hundred thousand men and women, and seized Jiali as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jing broke the Turks with three thousand fierce cavalry, and again with ten thousand elite horsemen reached Yinshan, beheaded more than a thousand, captured more than one hundred thousand men and women, and seized Jiali as tribute.

sentences.zh: 自漢以來，用少擊眾，不可勝數。

translations.literal: Since Han times, instances of striking many with few are beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Since Han times, instances of striking many with few are beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 竦在涇原守城壘，據險阻，來則禦之，去則釋之，不聞出師也。

translations.literal: Song at Jingyuan defended walled camps, held difficult terrain, repelled the enemy when they came and released them when they left — one never heard of his dispatching troops.
translations.idiomatic: Song at Jingyuan defended walled camps, held difficult terrain, repelled the enemy when they came and released them when they left — one never heard of his dispatching troops.

sentences.zh: 竦懼戰或敗衄，托以兵少為辭爾。

translations.literal: Song feared that battle might end in defeat and used insufficient troops as his excuse.
translations.idiomatic: Song feared that battle might end in defeat and used insufficient troops as his excuse.

sentences.zh: 竦言土兵各護鄉土，自古兵有九地，士卒近家，謂之散地，言其易離散也。

translations.literal: Song said that local troops each defend their native places. From antiquity troops have nine kinds of ground; when soldiers are near home it is called scattered ground, meaning they easily disperse.
translations.idiomatic: Song said that local troops each defend their native places. From antiquity troops have nine kinds of ground; when soldiers are near home it is called scattered ground, meaning they easily disperse.

sentences.zh: 第以近事言之，閣門祗候王文恩出師敗北，而土兵皆竄走，惟東兵僅二百人，殺敵兵甚眾。

translations.literal: Take only recent events: when Gate Attendant Wang Wen'en marched out and was defeated, local troops all fled, while only about two hundred eastern capital soldiers killed many enemy troops.
translations.idiomatic: Take only recent events: when Gate Attendant Wang Wen'en marched out and was defeated, local troops all fled, while only about two hundred eastern capital soldiers killed many enemy troops.

sentences.zh: 以此知兵之強弱，不係東西，在將有謀與無謀爾。

translations.literal: From this one knows that the strength or weakness of troops does not depend on east or west, but on whether the commander has strategy or not.
translations.idiomatic: From this one knows that the strength or weakness of troops does not depend on east or west, but on whether the commander has strategy or not.

sentences.zh: 今邊郡參用東兵、土兵，若盡罷東兵，亦非計也。

translations.literal: Today frontier prefectures use both eastern capital and local troops together. To abolish eastern capital troops entirely would also not be a good plan.
translations.idiomatic: Today frontier prefectures use both eastern capital and local troops together. To abolish eastern capital troops entirely would also not be a good plan.

sentences.zh: 古人有言：『非隴西之民有勇怯，乃將吏之制巧拙異也。』

translations.literal: The ancients said: 'It is not that the people of Longxi are brave or timid by nature, but that the commanders and officials differ in skill and clumsiness.'
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said: 'It is not that the people of Longxi are brave or timid by nature, but that the commanders and officials differ in skill and clumsiness.'

sentences.zh: 今防邊東兵，人月受米七斗五升，土兵二石五斗，而竦乃言東兵廩給至厚，又不知之甚也。

translations.literal: Today eastern capital frontier troops receive seven dou and five sheng of grain per man per month; local troops receive two shi and five dou. Yet Song says eastern capital troops receive extremely generous rations — he is profoundly ignorant.
translations.idiomatic: Today eastern capital frontier troops receive seven dou and five sheng of grain per man per month; local troops receive two shi and five dou. Yet Song says eastern capital troops receive extremely generous rations — he is profoundly ignorant.

sentences.zh: 竦又言募土兵訓練以代東兵，且土兵數萬，須募足訓練，雖三二歲未得成效，兵精猶恐奔北，豈有驟加訓練而能取勝哉？」

translations.literal: Song also says to recruit and train local troops to replace eastern capital troops. Yet local troops number in the tens of thousands; they must be recruited in full and trained. Even after two or three years there may be no result, and even sharp troops may fear defeat — how could sudden training make them victorious?"
translations.idiomatic: Song also says to recruit and train local troops to replace eastern capital troops. Yet local troops number in the tens of thousands; they must be recruited in full and trained. Even after two or three years there may be no result, and even sharp troops may fear defeat — how could sudden training make them victorious?"

sentences.zh: 竦議遂屈。

translations.literal: Song's proposal was thereupon defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Song's proposal was thereupon defeated.

sentences.zh: 竦雅意在朝廷，及任以西事，頗依違顧避，又數請解兵柄。

translations.literal: Song's heart had always been set on the court. When assigned to western affairs he wavered and looked for escape, and repeatedly requested to be relieved of military authority.
translations.idiomatic: Song's heart had always been set on the court. When assigned to western affairs he wavered and looked for escape, and repeatedly requested to be relieved of military authority.

sentences.zh: 改判河中府，徙蔡州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to govern Hezhong Prefecture, then moved to Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to govern Hezhong Prefecture, then moved to Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，召為樞密使。

translations.literal: During the Qingli era he was summoned as director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingli era he was summoned as director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 諫官、御史交章論：「竦在陝西畏懦不肯盡力，每論邊事，但列眾人之言，至遣敕使臨督，始陳十策。

translations.literal: Remonstrating officials and censors submitted memorials in succession: "Song in Shaanxi was timid and unwilling to exert himself. Whenever he discussed frontier affairs he merely listed what others had said. Only when an imperial envoy was dispatched to supervise him on the spot did he present his ten strategies.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrating officials and censors submitted memorials in succession: "Song in Shaanxi was timid and unwilling to exert himself. Whenever he discussed frontier affairs he merely listed what others had said. Only when an imperial envoy was dispatched to supervise him on the spot did he present his ten strategies.

sentences.zh: 嘗出巡邊，置侍婢中軍帳下，幾致軍變。

translations.literal: Once when he went out to inspect the frontier he placed serving maids in the central army tent, nearly causing a military mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Once when he went out to inspect the frontier he placed serving maids in the central army tent, nearly causing a military mutiny.

sentences.zh: 元昊嘗募得竦首者與錢三千，為賊輕侮如此。

translations.literal: Yuanhao once offered three thousand cash to whoever could obtain Song's head — such was the enemy's contempt for him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhao once offered three thousand cash to whoever could obtain Song's head — such was the enemy's contempt for him.

sentences.zh: 今復用之，邊將體解矣。

translations.literal: To employ him again now would utterly dishearten frontier generals.
translations.idiomatic: To employ him again now would utterly dishearten frontier generals.

sentences.zh: 且竦挾詐任數，奸邪傾險，與呂夷簡不相能。

translations.literal: Moreover, Song relies on deceit and stratagem, is treacherous, corrupt, and dangerous, and is incompatible with Lü Yijian.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Song relies on deceit and stratagem, is treacherous, corrupt, and dangerous, and is incompatible with Lü Yijian.

sentences.zh: 夷簡畏其為人，不肯引為同列，既退，乃薦之以釋宿憾。

translations.literal: Yijian feared his character and would not bring him in as a colleague. After retiring, he recommended Song to release an old grudge.
translations.idiomatic: Yijian feared his character and would not bring him in as a colleague. After retiring, he recommended Song to release an old grudge.

sentences.zh: 陛下孜孜政事，首用懷詐不忠之臣，何以求治？」

translations.literal: Your Majesty diligently attends to government affairs — to employ first a treacherous and disloyal minister, how can good order be sought?"
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty diligently attends to government affairs — to employ first a treacherous and disloyal minister, how can good order be sought?"

sentences.zh: 會竦已至國門，言者論不已，請不令入見。

translations.literal: It happened that Song had already reached the capital gates. The critics continued without cease and requested that he not be allowed an audience.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Song had already reached the capital gates. The critics continued without cease and requested that he not be allowed an audience.

sentences.zh: 諫官余靖又言：「竦累表引疾，及聞召用，即兼驛而馳。

translations.literal: Remonstrating official Yu Jing also said: "Song repeatedly submitted memorials citing illness, yet upon hearing of his summons he immediately rode post-haste.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrating official Yu Jing also said: "Song repeatedly submitted memorials citing illness, yet upon hearing of his summons he immediately rode post-haste.

sentences.zh: 若不早決，竦必堅求面對，敘恩感泣，復有左右為之地，則聖聽惑矣。」

translations.literal: If a decision is not made early, Song will surely insist on a face-to-face audience, recount favors and weep in gratitude, and again have attendants speak on his behalf — then the imperial ear will be confused."
translations.idiomatic: If a decision is not made early, Song will surely insist on a face-to-face audience, recount favors and weep in gratitude, and again have attendants speak on his behalf — then the imperial ear will be confused."

sentences.zh: 章累上，即日詔竦歸鎮，竦亦自請還節。

translations.literal: Memorials piled up. That same day an edict ordered Song back to his command, and Song also requested return of his seal of authority.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials piled up. That same day an edict ordered Song back to his command, and Song also requested return of his seal of authority.

sentences.zh: 徙知亳州，改授吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Bozhou and reassigned as minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefect of Bozhou and reassigned as minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 歲中，加資政殿學士。

translations.literal: Within the year he was given the additional title of academician of the Hall of Esteem.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year he was given the additional title of academician of the Hall of Esteem.

sentences.zh: 竦之及國門也，帝封彈疏示之，既至亳州，上書萬言自辨。

translations.literal: When Song reached the capital gates, the emperor sealed the impeachment memorials and showed them to him. After arriving at Bozhou, he submitted a ten-thousand-word memorial in self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Song reached the capital gates, the emperor sealed the impeachment memorials and showed them to him. After arriving at Bozhou, he submitted a ten-thousand-word memorial in self-defense.

sentences.zh: 復拜宣徽南院使、河陽三城節度使、判幷州。

translations.literal: He was again appointed commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, military commissioner of the Heyang Three Cities, and assigned to Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, military commissioner of the Heyang Three Cities, and assigned to Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 請復置宦者為走馬承受。

translations.literal: He requested restoration of eunuchs as mounted dispatch receivers.
translations.idiomatic: He requested restoration of eunuchs as mounted dispatch receivers.

sentences.zh: 明年，拜同中書門下平章事、判大名府。

translations.literal: The following year he was appointed grand councilor with equal standing at the Secretariat-Chancellery and assigned to Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed grand councilor with equal standing at the Secretariat-Chancellery and assigned to Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又明年，召入為宰相。

translations.literal: The year after that he was summoned to enter the capital as grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he was summoned to enter the capital as grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 制下，而諫官、御史復言：「大臣和則政事修，竦前在關中，與執中論議不合，不可使共事。」

translations.literal: When the appointment edict was issued, remonstrating officials and censors again said: "When senior ministers are harmonious, government affairs are well ordered. Song previously in Guanzhong disagreed in discussion with Zhizhong and cannot be allowed to serve together."
translations.idiomatic: When the appointment edict was issued, remonstrating officials and censors again said: "When senior ministers are harmonious, government affairs are well ordered. Song previously in Guanzhong disagreed in discussion with Zhizhong and cannot be allowed to serve together."

sentences.zh: 遂改樞密使，封英國公。

translations.literal: He was thereupon changed to director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: He was thereupon changed to director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 請析河北為四路。

translations.literal: He requested that Hebei be divided into four routes.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that Hebei be divided into four routes.

sentences.zh: 親事官夜入禁中，欲為亂，領皇城司者皆坐逐，獨楊懷敏降官，領入內都知如故。

translations.literal: A personal attendant entered the inner palace at night intending to create disorder. All who headed the Imperial City Office were punished with removal, but Yang Huai'min alone was demoted in rank yet retained his post as director of the Inner Service as before.
translations.idiomatic: A personal attendant entered the inner palace at night intending to create disorder. All who headed the Imperial City Office were punished with removal, but Yang Huai'min alone was demoted in rank yet retained his post as director of the Inner Service as before.

sentences.zh: 言者以為竦結懷敏而曲庇之。

translations.literal: Critics believed that Song had bonded with Huai'min and shielded him improperly.
translations.idiomatic: Critics believed that Song had bonded with Huai'min and shielded him improperly.

sentences.zh: 會京師同日無雲而震者五，帝方坐便殿，趣召翰林學士張方平至，謂曰：「夏竦奸邪，以致天變如此，宜出之。」

translations.literal: It happened that in the capital on the same day there were five thunderclaps without clouds. The emperor was sitting in the side hall and urgently summoned Hanlin academician Zhang Fangping, saying: "Xia Song is treacherous and corrupt, causing heavenly portents such as this. He should be removed."
translations.idiomatic: It happened that in the capital on the same day there were five thunderclaps without clouds. The emperor was sitting in the side hall and urgently summoned Hanlin academician Zhang Fangping, saying: "Xia Song is treacherous and corrupt, causing heavenly portents such as this. He should be removed."

sentences.zh: 罷知河南府，未幾，赴本鎮，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: He was removed to prefect of Henan Prefecture. Before long he went to his original command and was given the additional appointment as palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was removed to prefect of Henan Prefecture. Before long he went to his original command and was given the additional appointment as palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 饗明堂，徙武寧軍節度使，進鄭國公，錫賚與輔臣等。

translations.literal: At the Bright Hall sacrifice he was transferred to military commissioner of the Wuning Army, advanced to Duke of Zheng, and granted gifts equal to those of the senior ministers.
translations.idiomatic: At the Bright Hall sacrifice he was transferred to military commissioner of the Wuning Army, advanced to Duke of Zheng, and granted gifts equal to those of the senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 將相居外，遇大禮有賜，自竦始。

translations.literal: For generals and ministers residing outside the capital to receive gifts on great ceremonial occasions began with Song.
translations.idiomatic: For generals and ministers residing outside the capital to receive gifts on great ceremonial occasions began with Song.

sentences.zh: 尋以病歸，卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he returned home due to illness and died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he returned home due to illness and died.

sentences.zh: 贈太師、中書令。

translations.literal: He was posthumously honored as grand preceptor and director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as grand preceptor and director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 賜諡文正，劉敞言：「世謂竦奸邪，而諡為正，不可。」

translations.literal: He was granted the posthumous name Wenzheng. Liu Chang said: "The world calls Song treacherous and corrupt, yet his posthumous name is 'Correct' — this cannot stand."
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the posthumous name Wenzheng. Liu Chang said: "The world calls Song treacherous and corrupt, yet his posthumous name is 'Correct' — this cannot stand."

sentences.zh: 改諡文莊。

translations.literal: It was changed to Wenzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: It was changed to Wenzhuang.

sentences.zh: 竦以文學起家，有名一時，朝廷大典策屢以屬之。

translations.literal: Song rose through literary learning, was famous in his time, and the court repeatedly entrusted major state documents and edicts to him.
translations.idiomatic: Song rose through literary learning, was famous in his time, and the court repeatedly entrusted major state documents and edicts to him.

sentences.zh: 多識古文，學奇字，至夜以指畫膚。

translations.literal: He knew much ancient writing and studied unusual characters, tracing them on his skin with his finger even at night.
translations.idiomatic: He knew much ancient writing and studied unusual characters, tracing them on his skin with his finger even at night.

sentences.zh: 文集一百卷。

translations.literal: His collected writings numbered one hundred volumes.
translations.idiomatic: His collected writings numbered one hundred volumes.

sentences.zh: 其為郡有治績，喜作條教，於閭里立保伍之法，至盜賊不敢發，然人苦煩擾。

translations.literal: When governing prefectures he had a record of good administration. He liked to make detailed regulations, establishing the mutual-responsibility system in neighborhoods, so that bandits and thieves did not dare act — yet the people suffered from the burdensome interference.
translations.idiomatic: When governing prefectures he had a record of good administration. He liked to make detailed regulations, establishing the mutual-responsibility system in neighborhoods, so that bandits and thieves did not dare act — yet the people suffered from the burdensome interference.

sentences.zh: 治軍尤嚴，敢誅殺，即疾病死喪，拊循甚至。

translations.literal: In governing troops he was especially strict and dared to execute, yet for illness, death, or mourning he showed the utmost care and consolation.
translations.idiomatic: In governing troops he was especially strict and dared to execute, yet for illness, death, or mourning he showed the utmost care and consolation.

sentences.zh: 嘗有龍騎卒戍邊，群剽，州郡莫能止，或密以告竦。
