translations.literal: Once Dragon Cavalry soldiers garrisoned on the frontier banded together in plunder. Prefectures and districts could not stop them, and someone secretly reported this to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Once Dragon Cavalry soldiers garrisoned on the frontier banded together in plunder. Prefectures and districts could not stop them, and someone secretly reported this to Song.

sentences.zh: 時竦在關中，俟其至，召詰之，誅斬殆盡，軍中大震。

translations.literal: At that time Song was in Guanzhong. He waited for them to arrive, summoned and interrogated them, and executed nearly all of them. The army was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Song was in Guanzhong. He waited for them to arrive, summoned and interrogated them, and executed nearly all of them. The army was greatly shaken.

sentences.zh: 其威略多類此。

translations.literal: His authority and strategy were mostly of this sort.
translations.idiomatic: His authority and strategy were mostly of this sort.

sentences.zh: 然性貪，數商販部中。

translations.literal: Yet by nature he was greedy and repeatedly engaged in trade within his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Yet by nature he was greedy and repeatedly engaged in trade within his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 在幷州，使其僕貿易，為所侵盜，至杖殺之。

translations.literal: At Bingzhou he had his servant trade on his behalf. When the servant was robbed, Song beat him to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Bingzhou he had his servant trade on his behalf. When the servant was robbed, Song beat him to death.

sentences.zh: 積家財累鉅萬，自奉尤侈，畜聲伎甚眾。

translations.literal: He amassed household wealth totaling tens of thousands, lived in especially lavish style, and kept a great many singers and performers.
translations.idiomatic: He amassed household wealth totaling tens of thousands, lived in especially lavish style, and kept a great many singers and performers.

sentences.zh: 所在陰間僚屬，使相猜阻，以鉤致其事，遇家人亦然。

translations.literal: Wherever he was, he secretly set subordinates against one another so they would suspect and obstruct each other, thereby entangling them in affairs. He treated his own family the same way.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he was, he secretly set subordinates against one another so they would suspect and obstruct each other, thereby entangling them in affairs. He treated his own family the same way.

translations.literal: 〈Son〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Son〉

sentences.zh: 安期

translations.literal: Anqi
translations.idiomatic: Anqi

sentences.zh: 子安期，字清卿，以父任為將作監主簿，召試，賜進士出身。

translations.literal: His son Anqi, styled Qingqing, entered office through his father's privilege as registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings. He was summoned for examination and granted the status of jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: His son Anqi, courtesy name Qingqing, entered office through his father's privilege as registrar of the Directorate of Palace Buildings. He was summoned for examination and granted the status of jinshi.

sentences.zh: 累遷太常博士，擢提點荊湖南道刑獄。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was elevated to judicial intendant of the Jinghu South Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was elevated to judicial intendant of the Jinghu South Circuit.

sentences.zh: 除開封府推官，徙判官，判三司鹽鐵勾院，出為京西轉運使。

translations.literal: He was appointed investigating magistrate of Kaifeng Prefecture, transferred to judge, assigned to the Salt and Iron Verification Office of the Three Departments, and sent out as transport commissioner of the Western Capital Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed investigating magistrate of Kaifeng Prefecture, transferred to judge, assigned to the Salt and Iron Verification Office of the Three Departments, and sent out as transport commissioner of the Western Capital Circuit.

sentences.zh: 盜起部中，剽劫州縣，而光化軍戍卒相繼叛，勢且相合，安期督將吏捕斬殆盡。

translations.literal: Bandits arose within his jurisdiction, plundering prefectures and counties. Garrison soldiers of Guanghua Army rebelled one after another, and the forces were about to join together. Anqi supervised generals and officials in capturing and executing nearly all of them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits arose within his jurisdiction, plundering prefectures and counties. Garrison soldiers of Guanghua Army rebelled one after another, and the forces were about to join together. Anqi supervised generals and officials in capturing and executing nearly all of them.

sentences.zh: 徙河東轉運使，累遷尚書工部郎中，徙江、淮發運使，入為三司戶部副使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to transport commissioner of Hedong, promoted in succession to bureau director in the Ministry of Works, moved to grain transport commissioner of the Jianghuai region, and entered the capital as vice commissioner of the Revenue Office in the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to transport commissioner of Hedong, promoted in succession to bureau director in the Ministry of Works, moved to grain transport commissioner of the Jianghuai region, and entered the capital as vice commissioner of the Revenue Office in the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 會元昊納款，西邊罷兵，命往陝西與諸路經略安撫司議損邊費，頗奏省吏員及汰邊兵之不任役者五萬人。

translations.literal: When Yuanhao submitted, hostilities on the western frontier ceased, and Anqi was ordered to go to Shaanxi to consult with the frontier pacification commissions of the various routes on reducing frontier expenses. He memorialized extensively to cut clerical posts and eliminate fifty thousand frontier troops unfit for service.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanhao submitted, hostilities on the western frontier ceased, and Anqi was ordered to go to Shaanxi to consult with the frontier pacification commissions of the various routes on reducing frontier expenses. He memorialized extensively to cut clerical posts and eliminate fifty thousand frontier troops unfit for service.

sentences.zh: 擢天章閣待制，遂為陝西都轉運使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to awaiting-drafter of the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and then made overall transport commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to awaiting-drafter of the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and then made overall transport commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 徙河北，進兵部郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hebei and promoted to bureau director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Hebei and promoted to bureau director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 時竦為樞密使，為請還所遷官，丐淮、浙一郡。

translations.literal: At that time Song was director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and requested on his son's behalf the return of the ranks he had been promoted through, asking for a prefecture in Huai or Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Song was director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and requested on his son's behalf the return of the ranks he had been promoted through, asking for a prefecture in Huai or Zhe.

sentences.zh: 復以為工部郎中、江淮發運使，徙知永興軍。

translations.literal: He was again made bureau director in the Ministry of Works and grain transport commissioner of the Jianghuai region, then transferred to prefect of Yongxing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made bureau director in the Ministry of Works and grain transport commissioner of the Jianghuai region, then transferred to prefect of Yongxing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 進龍圖閣直學士、吏部郎中、知渭州。

translations.literal: He was advanced to direct academician of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, and prefect of Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to direct academician of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams, bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, and prefect of Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 簡弓箭手，得驍勇萬人為步兵，騎又半之，教以戰陣法，繇是土兵勝他路。

translations.literal: He selected archers and obtained ten thousand fierce warriors as infantry, with half that number as cavalry. He taught them battle formations, and from this local troops surpassed those of other routes.
translations.idiomatic: He selected archers and obtained ten thousand fierce warriors as infantry, with half that number as cavalry. He taught them battle formations, and from this local troops surpassed those of other routes.

sentences.zh: 又籍塞下閑田，募人耕種，歲得穀數萬斛，以備振發，名曰貸倉。

translations.literal: He also registered idle land below the frontier passes, recruited people to cultivate it, and each year obtained tens of thousands of hu of grain to prepare for relief distribution. It was called the Loan Granary.
translations.idiomatic: He also registered idle land below the frontier passes, recruited people to cultivate it, and each year obtained tens of thousands of hu of grain to prepare for relief distribution. It was called the Loan Granary.

sentences.zh: 遷右諫議大夫，進樞密直學士，徙延州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to right censor-in-chief, advanced to direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and moved to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to right censor-in-chief, advanced to direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and moved to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 未至，丁父憂。

translations.literal: Before he arrived he entered mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: Before he arrived he entered mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 服除，辭所進職，復為龍圖閣直學士兼侍讀，提舉集禧觀。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he declined the ranks to which he had been advanced and again served as direct academician of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams with concurrent appointment as reader-in-waiting, with charge of the Jixi Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he declined the ranks to which he had been advanced and again served as direct academician of the Hall of Dragon Diagrams with concurrent appointment as reader-in-waiting, with charge of the Jixi Abbey.

sentences.zh: 以學士復知延州，州東北阻山，無城郭，虜騎嘗乘之。

translations.literal: As academician he again became prefect of Yanzhou. The northeast of the prefecture was blocked by mountains and had no walls or moats; barbarian cavalry had often exploited this.
translations.idiomatic: As academician he again became prefect of Yanzhou. The northeast of the prefecture was blocked by mountains and had no walls or moats; barbarian cavalry had often exploited this.

sentences.zh: 安期至，即大築城。

translations.literal: When Anqi arrived he immediately undertook major construction of the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: When Anqi arrived he immediately undertook major construction of the city walls.

sentences.zh: 時方暑，士卒有怨言，安期益令廣袤計數百步，令其下曰：「敢言者斬。」

translations.literal: It was then the height of summer and the soldiers murmured complaints. Anqi further ordered the walls extended to several hundred paces in length and breadth and told his subordinates: "Whoever dares speak out will be executed."
translations.idiomatic: It was then the height of summer and the soldiers murmured complaints. Anqi further ordered the walls extended to several hundred paces in length and breadth and told his subordinates: "Whoever dares speak out will be executed."

sentences.zh: 躬自督役，不逾月而就。

translations.literal: He personally supervised the labor, and within a month it was completed.
translations.idiomatic: He personally supervised the labor, and within a month it was completed.

sentences.zh: 元昊請畫疆界，朝廷欲遣使，以問安期。

translations.literal: Yuanhao requested that the border be demarcated. The court wished to dispatch an envoy and consulted Anqi.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhao requested that the border be demarcated. The court wished to dispatch an envoy and consulted Anqi.

sentences.zh: 安期對曰：「此不足煩王人，衙校可辦也。」

translations.literal: Anqi replied: "This is not worth troubling an imperial envoy — a yamen officer can handle it."
translations.idiomatic: Anqi replied: "This is not worth troubling an imperial envoy — a yamen officer can handle it."

sentences.zh: 議遂決。

translations.literal: The decision was thereupon made.
translations.idiomatic: The decision was thereupon made.

sentences.zh: 暴得疾，卒，詔遣中使護其喪以歸。

translations.literal: He suddenly fell ill and died. An edict dispatched a palace envoy to escort his coffin home.
translations.idiomatic: He suddenly fell ill and died. An edict dispatched a palace envoy to escort his coffin home.

sentences.zh: 安期雖乘世資，頗以才自厲，朝廷數器使之，然無學術，而求入侍經筵，為世所譏。

translations.literal: Although Anqi rose through hereditary privilege, he strove to improve himself through talent and the court repeatedly valued and employed him. Yet he lacked scholarly learning and sought to enter service at the imperial lecture hall, for which the world mocked him.
translations.idiomatic: Although Anqi rose through hereditary privilege, he strove to improve himself through talent and the court repeatedly valued and employed him. Yet he lacked scholarly learning and sought to enter service at the imperial lecture hall, for which the world mocked him.

sentences.zh: 其奉養聲伎，不減其父云。

translations.literal: In maintaining singers and performers he was no less than his father, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: In maintaining singers and performers he was no less than his father, it is said.

sentences.zh: 論曰：王欽若、丁謂、夏竦，世皆指為奸邪。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Wang Qinruo, Ding Wei, and Xia Song — the world all pointed to them as treacherous and corrupt.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Wang Qinruo, Ding Wei, and Xia Song — the world all pointed to them as treacherous and corrupt.

sentences.zh: 真宗時，海內乂安，文治洽和，群臣將順不暇，而封禪之議成於謂，天書之誣造端於欽若，所謂以道事君者，固如是耶？

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Zhenzong, the realm within the seas was at peace and civil governance was harmonious. The ministers had no leisure but to comply — yet the proposal for the Fengshan sacrifice was completed by Wei, and the fabrication of the Heavenly Writ originated with Qinruo. Is this what is meant by serving one's lord through the Way?
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Emperor Zhenzong, the realm within the seas was at peace and civil governance was harmonious. The ministers had no leisure but to comply — yet the proposal for the Fengshan sacrifice was completed by Wei, and the fabrication of the Heavenly Writ originated with Qinruo. Is this what is meant by serving one's lord through the Way?

sentences.zh: 竦陰謀猜阻，鉤致成事，一居政府，排斥相踵，何其患得患失也！

translations.literal: Song engaged in secret plots, suspicion, and obstruction, entangling others to achieve his ends. Once he entered the government, exclusions followed one after another — how fearful of loss and eager for gain he was!
translations.idiomatic: Song engaged in secret plots, suspicion, and obstruction, entangling others to achieve his ends. Once he entered the government, exclusions followed one after another — how fearful of loss and eager for gain he was!

sentences.zh: 欽若以贓賄幹吏議，其得免者幸矣。

translations.literal: Qinruo interfered in the deliberations of officials through bribery; that he escaped punishment was fortunate indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Qinruo interfered in the deliberations of officials through bribery; that he escaped punishment was fortunate indeed.

sentences.zh: 然而黨惡醜正，幾敗國家，謂其尤者哉。

translations.literal: Yet in forming factions of the wicked and disfiguring the upright, they nearly ruined the state — of these Wei was the worst.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in forming factions of the wicked and disfiguring the upright, they nearly ruined the state — of these Wei was the worst.
